These conditions may lead to reduced visibility, strong winds, and localized flooding. The public is strongly advised to remain vigilant during this period, limit outdoor activities, and take all necessary precautions to ensure safety. Conditions are expected to gradually improve by 12 October 2025, 18:00 WIB.
